title_en: Reply Opinions of the Administrative Division of the Supreme People's Court on the Acceptance of Disputes over the Collection of Fees for Paid Use of Urban Drainage Facilities

articles.content_en:
Reply Opinion of the Administrative Adjudication Division of the Supreme People's Court
on Acceptance of Dispute Cases Arising from the Collection of Fees for Use of Urban Drainage Facilities
August 24, 1996 [1996] Law Administration (Division) No. 10
Higher People's Court of Hubei Province:
We have received your Request for Instructions on Whether the People's Court May Accept as Economic Dispute Cases the Disputes Arising from the Collection of Fees for Use of Urban Drainage Facilities. After study, we reply as follows:
The disputes arising between a relevant department, authorized by the People's Government, in collecting fees for use of urban drainage facilities and its administrative counterpart shall be administrative disputes. Pursuant to Article 11 of the Administrative Procedure Law, where an administrative counterpart refuses to accept a handling decision made by the relevant department and brings a prosecution to the People's Court according to law, the People's Court shall accept it as an administrative case. Where an administrative counterpart neither institutes a prosecution within the statutory period nor performs the administrative handling decision, the relevant department that made the administrative handling decision may apply to the People's Court for compulsory execution according to law.
